title: Name and address of the manufacturer, packer or importer
requirement: The package must state the name of the manufacturer, or of the manufacturer and the packer where they differ, or - for an imported package - of the importer. Any one of these satisfies the check. The completeness of the ADDRESS is not checked here; that is rule 10(1).
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
source_note: Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code (automated legal-source check) for raghavrrrao against the Department of Consumer Affairs (Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution) consolidated publication 'Book on Legal Metrology Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011 with all amendments', https://consumeraffairs.gov.in/public/upload/admin/cmsfiles/whatsnews/Book_on_Legal_Metrology_Packaged_Commodities_Rules,2011_with_all_amendments_whatsnews.pdf (sha256 0ef948f9c6b89f5dfb20d384861901714fd0dc54fc67b5b86c772d2c3f983a4b; server Last-Modified 2025-04-14). Clause (a) reads there, verbatim: 'the name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer and for any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned.' Explanation III, as substituted vide G.S.R. 629(E) dated 23rd June 2017 w.e.f. 1.1.2018, reads verbatim: 'In respect of packages containing food articles, the provisions of this clause shall not apply, but the provisions of, and the requirements specified in the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (34 of 2006) and the rules made thereunder shall apply;'. AS OF STEP 2 THIS RULE IS EVALUATED, on the NAME only - see the _comment keys and rules/SOURCES.md. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW BY A NAMED REVIEWER IS STILL OUTSTANDING.
_comment_1: Rule 6(1)(a) LMPC 2011 - manufacturer / packer / importer declaration.
_comment_2: STEP 2 ACTIVATION. This rule shipped inactive because clause (a) is DISJUNCTIVE - a package satisfies it by declaring the manufacturer, OR the manufacturer and the packer, OR (for an imported package) the importer - and field_presence tests exactly one field_key, so a rule keyed on manufacturer_name reported a lawfully labelled imported package as NON_COMPLIANT. check_type is now field_presence_any_of, which tests the disjunction the clause actually states.
_comment_3: SCOPE OF WHAT IS CHECKED: the NAME only. The ADDRESS half of clause (a) is NOT checked, because manufacturer_address is in the extractor's UNSUPPORTED_KEYS and rule 10(1) is the operative provision for address completeness. The requirement text below says so, so a finding cannot read as a broader claim than was tested.
_comment_4: Explanation III (food articles -> Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006) is encoded twice over: by targeting packaged-non-food here, and as an EXEMPTS applicability link on the 6(1)(a) requirement in the framework.
